title: Capability Exposure Accounting for Threshold-Based Encrypted Backup Recovery: research artifact
description: Manuscript source, Python checkers and reference kernel, unit tests, TLA+ models and TLC configurations, a reference data layer, benchmark samples and plotting scripts.
